content: Embedded test pyramid: host unit tests (native env, Unity/GoogleTest) are fast and numerous; simulation/emulation (Wokwi, Renode, QEMU) covers peripheral and timing behavior at medium cost; HIL with real silicon is slowest/scarcest and reserved for physics-dependent behavior. PlatformIO supports native and embedded test environments. Wokwi CLI/CI runs firmware in cloud simulation, validates diagram.json, and asserts serial/scenario output; Renode uses Robot Framework; pytest + serial is a common HIL harness. Simulation can produce false greens and must not be presented as hardware evidence.
